notes.title: Abstract Hell 1.2
notes.content:
A new version of Abstract Hell is released. Some creatures are now easier to deal with, there is a spawn rate slider for customizing game difficulty, and there is a new upgrade which allows you to spawn one turret on each level.

As always, feedback is appreciated.

notes.title: Abstract Hell 1.1.0
notes.content: This update introduces a handful of minor bug fixes, 1 test achievement to make sure the achievement system is working, and an 11th level. Enjoy! As always, feedback is encouraged.

notes.title: Abstract Hell is released!
notes.content:
After a few months of work, Abstract Hell is now released on Steam!

Feedback and suggestions from the community are always welcome! The release is not the end. As long as it's easy to do so, Abstract Hell will receive content updates indefinitely.

Look for announcements and follow the Ruby-3 Twitter and YouTube channel to see things early!

https://twitter.com/ruby3produxns
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC7AAGR8fJbJpQRc_67wj4PQ

notes.title: Abstract Hell is getting ready for release!
notes.content:
In the meantime, stay tuned for more screenshots, video footage, and streams. Follow the YouTube channel, Twitter, or Steam page to stay up to date, ask questions, and give feedback.
